materialBinding.uvConvention: OBJ vt coordinates with bottom-left origin; V increases from the negative-Y pole to the positive-Y pole
materialBinding.sampling: Multiply the OBJ UVs by uvScale, then add uvOffset for every bound texture. The threepp adapter's compensation for shared terrain texture transforms is not part of this portable binding.

source: Original procedural fieldstone authored for this project; offline source scripts/ground-v2-bake-boulder.mjs
notes: Static portable OBJ with UVs and explicit welded smooth normals; no runtime procedural dependency. Reuses material.forest-floor textures. 56 nondegenerate triangles versus the previous70-slot boulder.
